title: Kekulé and delocalised benzene
caption: Kekulé's structure has alternating single (0.154 nm) and double (0.134 nm) bonds. X-ray diffraction finds every C–C bond 0.139 nm, so the six π electrons are delocalised round the ring, drawn as a circle.
alt: Two Kekulé structures of benzene with a double-headed arrow between them, and the delocalised structure with a circle in the ring.
description: Left and centre: the two Kekulé structures, double bonds in alternate positions.
Right: the hexagon with a circle, all bonds equal at 0.139 nm.
